_note: Coin purse timings (Lib/CoinBox). Times in seconds, rates per second, distances in pixels (1920x1080).

roll._note: the number on the pill eases to the balance at rate_per_s, and snaps to it once within snap

pay._note: the price label drops into the purse over drop_s, fading by drop_fade. count coins start start_from_right px left of the pill's right edge, step_x px apart leftwards, start_dy px over its top plus (i % row_cycle) * row_dy; coin i flies for dur_s + (i % dur_cycle) * dur_step_s, after i * delay_step_s. The balance starts rolling after roll_delay_s

gain._note: the green +n rises rise_px out of the purse over rise_s. count coins start start_from_left px right of the pill's left edge, step_x px apart, start_dy px over its top plus (i % row_cycle) * row_dy; coin i flies for dur_s + (i % dur_cycle) * dur_step_s, after i * delay_step_s. The balance starts rolling after roll_delay_s

coin_flight._note: a flying coin arcs arc_px over its straight path; its wobble turns wobble_freq radians per flight
